upstream.note: CI downloads this tarball (device disk is ~1.4 GB free; no local submodule checkout).

webkit.note: JSC is never compiled here; scripts/build/deps/webkit.ts fetches the prebuilt into --cache-dir. Pins are for cache validation and drift detection.

tools.llvm_note: From this release onward llvm/llvm-project publishes no clang+llvm linux-x64 ubuntu flavour; LLVM-<ver>-Linux-X64.tar.xz is the official prebuilt clang+lld bundle.

android.note: ANDROID_API_LEVEL_DEFAULT=28 upstream; not overridable via scripts/build.ts CLI fields (androidApiLevel is a config field, default applies). Official JSC prebuilt is compiled against android28.

official_android_release.note: Reference only: the official 1.4.2 android asset was validated on this phone 2026-10-06. This project builds from source with Termux fixes.

local_repo_deviation.source: tarball-fetch in CI instead of a locally initialized submodule (device disk constraint), documented in README
local_repo_deviation.patches: patches/android/*.patch applied with git am over the pinned tree; never a dirty checkout
